name: hermes-model-panel
description: Responsive self-hosted administration panel for Hermes Agent models, relays, profiles, chat platforms, tools, and Skills

scripts.syntax: node --check server.js && node --check public/js/app.js && python3 -m compileall -q scripts
scripts.lint: eslint server.js src public/js tests && stylelint public/css/app.css && python3 -m ruff check scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json eslint.config.js playwright.config.js src tests/*.test.mjs README.md README.en.md && python3 -m ruff format --check scripts
scripts.check: npm run syntax && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
